title: 第15章揪着兔耳朵，小舞的兽奴新身份-《斗罗V：开局绑定朱竹清，创建神级家族》
content:
第(1/3)页

    小舞看到叶寒，脸色骤然一变，有点心虚地往后退了几步。

    “你，你怎么跟过来了。”

    “我，我就是睡不着，想出来逛逛，没想着要逃离史莱克学院。”

    叶寒望着她那慌张的样子，就知道他刚才的猜想是对的，脸色一冷，闪身来到她的面前，“小兔子，你觉得我会相信？”

    小舞见叶寒直接点破她的身份，神色十分慌张，但她还是不想接受这个现实，死不承认。

    “我不是兔子，我是人类，叫小舞。”

    “叶寒老大，你不能污蔑我。”

    此时，她的兔耳朵变得耷拉、缩起来，显然很害怕、很紧张。

    她的眼神也在闪避，不敢与叶寒对视，只能往下看。

    “你不是兔子，你紧张什么，为何不敢看我。”

    叶寒对小舞的兔耳朵产生了浓厚的兴趣。

    他发现，小舞的兔耳朵会随着她的情绪而有不同的变化。

    看久了会觉得很可爱。

    或许，这就是小舞化形为人后的短板，也是她最敏感、最脆弱的地方。

    “我，我没有。”

    “我只是在想事情。”

    小舞见叶寒好像能看穿她的心中所想，赶紧把头抬起来，调整害怕而又紧张的情绪。

    “既然你说你是人类，那这两只兔耳朵就是装饰品。”

    “我挺喜欢这两只兔耳朵，倒不如给我吧。”

    叶寒见她死不承认，伸手向她的兔耳朵抓去。

    小舞见之，脸色骤然一变，迅速闪避，向小森林深处逃去，口中喊道：“叶寒老大，你不能这样。”

    叶寒可听不进去，更不会让小舞逃了，只见他双腿用力一蹬，便瞬间追了上去，伸手抓住她的两只兔耳朵。

    就在此时，小舞浑身微微一颤，双腿发软，瘫坐在地。

    她的兔耳朵也在此刻开始发烫起来，变得通红一片。

    “你的兔耳朵装饰品还挺像。”

    “你不想给，那我就只能强行将其扯断了。”

    叶寒见小舞还不服软，承认真实身份，手上微微一用力，拉扯兔耳朵。

    “啊......”

    “叶寒老大，你住手，我承认我是兔子。”

    小舞感知到兔耳朵传来的刺痛，赶紧向他承认身份。

    兔耳朵可不是简单的耳朵，而是武魂本体、灵魂和肉身要害融为一体的关键部位。

    若是叶寒将她的兔耳朵直接扯断，她武魂、灵魂和身体都会遭受严重的损伤，让她瞬间失去战斗力，甚至直接瘫软、晕厥，精神力大幅溃散。

    到那时候，她的本源就会严重受损，根基被毁，修为暴跌，很难再有重新修炼的机会。

    如果没人救治，没有神丹妙药修复，她的本源就会慢慢枯竭，神魂消散，最后慢慢陨落。

    所以兔耳朵就是她最大的弱点，也是识破她真实身份的唯一证据。

    “呵呵，现在承认了。”

    “早干嘛去了。”

    “说，你到底是怎么变成人类的。”

    叶寒见她终于承认了，嘴角扬起得意的冷笑。

    只要掌握了小舞的弱点，就能掌控她的人生，为他所用。

    “老大，我起初是一只十万年魂兽。”

    “因为一些原因，我选择了化形为人这条路，想成为一名真正的人类。”

    “为了变成人类，我舍弃了十万年修为。”
    第(1/3)页

When Xiao Wu saw Ye Han, her expression suddenly changed and she took a few steps back with a guilty conscience.

"You, why are you following me?"

"I, I just can't sleep. I want to go out for a walk, but I don't want to escape from Shrek Academy."

Ye Han looked at her panicked look and knew that his guess just now was right. His face turned cold and he ducked in front of her, "Little Rabbit, do you think I will believe it?"

Seeing Ye Han directly reveal her identity, Xiao Wu looked very panicked, but she still didn't want to accept this reality and refused to admit it.

"I'm not a rabbit, I'm a human, my name is Xiao Wu."

"Boss Ye Han, you can't slander me."

At this time, her rabbit ears became droopy and shrunk, and she was obviously very scared and nervous.

Her eyes were also evasive, not daring to look at Ye Han, so she could only look down.

"You are not a rabbit. Why are you nervous? Why don't you dare to look at me."

Ye Han became very interested in Xiao Wu's rabbit ears.

He discovered that Xiao Wu’s bunny ears would change differently depending on her mood.

​​You will find it very cute after looking at it for a long time.

“Perhaps, this is Xiao Wu’s shortcoming after transforming into a human being, and it is also her most sensitive and vulnerable place.

“I, I didn’t.”

"I'm just thinking about things."

Seeing that Ye Han seemed to be able to see through her thoughts, Xiao Wu quickly raised her head to adjust her fearful and nervous mood.

"Since you said you are human, these two rabbit ears are decorations."

“I really like these two rabbit ears, why not give them to me.”

Seeing that she refused to admit it, Ye Han stretched out his hand to grab her rabbit ears.

When Xiao Wu saw this, his expression suddenly changed, he quickly dodged and fled deep into the small forest, shouting: "Boss Ye Han, you can't do this."

Ye Han couldn't listen, let alone let Xiao Wu escape. He kicked his legs hard and immediately chased after her, reaching out to grab her two rabbit ears.

At this moment, Xiao Wu's whole body trembled slightly, her legs became weak, and she collapsed on the ground.

Her bunny ears also began to heat up at this moment, turning red.

"Your bunny ear decorations look quite similar."

"If you don't want to give it, then I will have to tear it off by force."

Seeing that Xiao Wu was still unyielding, Ye Han admitted his true identity and pulled the rabbit's ears with a slight force on his hand.

"Ah..."

"Boss Ye Han, stop, I admit that I am a rabbit."

Xiao Wu felt the stinging pain from the rabbit’s ears and quickly admitted her identity to him.

​​ Rabbit ears are not just simple ears, but a key part of the vital integration of the spirit body, soul and body.

"If Ye Han directly tears off her rabbit ears, her martial spirit, soul and body will be severely damaged, causing her to lose her combat effectiveness instantly, or even become paralyzed, faint, and her mental strength will be greatly weakened.

By that time, her origin will be seriously damaged, her foundation will be destroyed, her cultivation will plummet, and it will be difficult for her to have a chance to practice again.

"If no one treats her, if there is no magical elixir to repair her, her origin will slowly dry up, her spirit will dissipate, and she will eventually fall.

So the rabbit ears are her biggest weakness and the only evidence to reveal her true identity.

"Haha, I admit it now."

"What were you doing earlier?"

"Tell me, how did you become a human being?"

Seeing that she finally admitted it, Ye Han raised a proud sneer at the corner of his mouth.

“As long as he grasps Xiao Wu’s weaknesses, he can control her life and use it for his own advantage.

“Boss, I started out as a hundred-thousand-year-old soul beast.”

"For some reasons, I chose the path of becoming a human being and wanted to become a real human being."

"In order to become a human, I gave up a hundred thousand years of cultivation."

title_en: Chapter 15: Holding the rabbit ears, Xiao Wu’s new identity as a beast slave - "Douluo V: Binding Zhu Zhuqing at the beginning to create a god-level family"
